versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Privacy Compliance Assistant skill.
- Instantly generate Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) and DPO advisory reports aligned with GDPR, CCPA, and global regulations.
- Accepts company type, data types, processing purpose, systems used, and data sharing relationships as input.
- Returns PIA, ROPA, legal basis analysis, data subject rights checklist, third-party risk summary, and remediation actions.
- Provides API reference, example input/output, and pricing details.
